preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string `s` is a lowercase letter from 'a' to 'z'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (all(s[i] <= s[i+1] for i in range(len(s)-1)))
postconditions.description: The function returns `true` if and only if every character in `s` is less than or equal to the next character in alphabetical order (i.e., the string is in non-decreasing alphabetical order).
